purpose: A salaried, mass-market customer built to show EVERY page with real results: a genuine FAR-Trans trading history for the risk model, twelve months of reported income, spending and saving for the behaviour findings, an emergency fund above the six-month target, a regular monthly investment, a full questionnaire and three realistic goals. The application takes it through risk, goals, market regime, a risk-conditioned allocation, compliance, a recommendation and an explanation, and every number is computed by the application, not stored here. Synthetic identity; the only real data is the linked anonymised FAR-Trans history.

risk_data_link.selected_by: backend/scripts/find_demo_risk_candidates.py (confidence >= 0.60, >= 12 months of trading history), then checked against customer_information.csv
risk_data_link.note: an anonymised FAR-Trans customer with 52 months of trading history (370 transactions, 2018-01 to 2022-11) whose dataset label is a genuine 'Balanced' (not a Predicted_* or Not_Available row); the risk model, not this file, decides the category
